info.album: Take Me To Church (Live From Dermot O’Leary’s Saturday Sessions / 2016)

podcast.body: The 2013 music video for Hozier's "Take Me to Church" achieved over a billion views on YouTube, generating an estimated $5 million in royalties for the artist. Remarkably, the total production cost for this highly successful video was only $17 million, demonstrating how videos with modest budgets could achieve massive reach and financial return in the streaming era. "This 2013 video from Hoseaer, which has had more than a billion views on YouTube. A rough estimate says that that's worth about $5 million in royalties. And the total cost of this video? $17 million."
